📱 Android

Verify Authenticator App Settings

Make sure sign-in prompts reach you reliably

1

Verify that notifications are turned ON for the Authenticator app

  • Select "Settings" (fig. 1)
  • Select "Apps" (fig. 2)
  • Select "Authenticator" (fig. 3)
Figure 1
Select "Settings"
Figure 2
Select "Apps"
Figure 3
Select "Authenticator"
  • Select "Notifications" (fig. 4)
  • Verify notification settings as shown in image (fig. 5)
Figure 4
Set to "Allowed"
Figure 5
Verify these settings
2

Change battery settings for Authenticator

  • While in Authenticator app settings, select "Battery" (fig. 6)
  • Select "Unrestricted" (fig. 7)
Figure 6
Select "Battery"
Figure 7
Select "Unrestricted"
3

Enable Authenticator as a passkey provider

  • Go into Settings and search for "passkey" — select "Passwords, passkeys, and autofill" from the search results (fig. 8)
  • Select "Passwords, passkeys, and autofill" (fig. 9)
  • Enable the "Authenticator" option (fig. 10)
Figure 8
Search "passkey" and select "Passwords, passkeys, and autofill"
Figure 9
Select "Passwords, passkeys, and autofill"
Figure 10
Enable "Microsoft Authenticator"
